changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.dictionary_category (id, name, description, local_abbrev, lastupdated) SELECT nextval('clinlims.dictionary_category_seq'), 'TB Order Reasons', 'TB Order Reasons', 'TBORDER', now() WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.dictionary_category WHERE description = 'TB Order Reasons'); INSERT INTO clinlims.dictionary (id, is_active, dict_entry, lastupdated, local_abbrev, dictionary_category_id, sort_order) SELECT nextval('clinlims.dictionary_seq'), 'Y', 'Diagnostic', now(), 'Diagnostic', c.id, 10 FROM clinlims.dictionary_category c WHERE c.description = 'TB Order Reasons' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.dictionary d WHERE d.dictionary_category_id = c.id AND d.dict_entry = 'Diagnostic'); INSERT INTO clinlims.dictionary (id, is_active, dict_entry, lastupdated, local_abbrev, dictionary_category_id, sort_order) SELECT nextval('clinlims.dictionary_seq'), 'Y', 'Follow up', now(), 'Follow up', c.id, 20 FROM clinlims.dictionary_category c WHERE c.description = 'TB Order Reasons' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.dictionary d WHERE d.dictionary_category_id = c.id AND d.dict_entry = 'Follow up');
